Meta acquires Conductor. The cloud service shuts down in days.

Meta has acquired AI coding startup Conductor, founded in 2024. While the core product launched last summer and will function normally until early next year according to Holtz, the company’s cloud service is terminating immediately. Users face a hard deadline of November 20 for data deletion. This acquisition signals Meta’s aggressive push into developer tools, but existing users must migrate their workloads before the shutdown begins. The immediate impact is operational disruption for those relying on Conductor's hosted infrastructure rather than just the software logic.
